candidates.title: Violent Crime & Property Crime by County: 1975 to Present
candidates.description: The data are provided are the Maryland Statistical Analysis Center (MSAC), within the Governor's Office of Crime Control and Prevention (GOCCP). MSAC, in turn, receives these data from the Maryland State Police's annual Uniform Crime Reports.

candidates.title: Violent Crime & Property Crime by Municipality: 2000 to Present
candidates.description: The data are provided are the Maryland Statistical Analysis Center (MSAC), within the Governor's Office of Crime Control and Prevention (GOCCP). MSAC, in turn, receives these data from the Maryland State Police's annual Uniform Crime Reports.

candidates.title: Violent Crime & Property Crime Statewide Totals: 1975 to Present
candidates.description: The data are provided are the Maryland Statistical Analysis Center (MSAC), within the Governor's Office of Crime Control and Prevention (GOCCP). MSAC, in turn, receives these data from the FBI's annual Uniform Crime Reports.

candidates.title: Anne Arundel County Crime Rate By Type
candidates.description: Historical crime rates per 100,000 people, 1975 - present. In June 2017 we changed the update frequency of this dataset from annual to as-needed because sometimes there is a lag that is often 6 months after the annual date before the new data is available.

candidates.title: Violent Crime & Property Crime Statewide Totals: 2006 to Present
candidates.description: This dataset shows Maryland crime versus all other states. The data are provided are the Maryland Statistical Analysis Center (MSAC), within the Governor's Office of Crime Control and Prevention (GOCCP). MSAC, in turn, receives these data from the FBI's annual Uniform Crime Reports.

candidates.title: Violent Crime Statewide Totals by Type
candidates.description: The data are provided are the Maryland Statistical Analysis Center (MSAC), within the Governor's Office of Crime Control and Prevention (GOCCP). MSAC, in turn, receives these data from the FBI's annual Uniform Crime Reports.

candidates.title: Violent Crimes by County: 2006 to 2013
candidates.description: This dataset shows the total number of violent crimes by county and statewide, for CY2006 versus CY2013. Data are provided by the Maryland Statistical Analysis Center (MSAC) within the Governor's Office of Crime Control and Prevention (GOCCP).

candidates.title: Cumulative Violent Crime Reduction - 2006 to 2014
candidates.description: This dataset tracks the cumulative statewide reductions in violent crime since 2006. Data are reported each year by MSAC, the Maryland Statistical Analysis Center, within GOCCP, the Governor's Office of Crime Control and Prevention.

candidates.title: Anne Arundel County Crime Totals By Type
candidates.description: Historical crime totals by type, 1975 - present. In June 2017 we changed the update frequency to as-needed because there is often a lag in getting this data updated because of the nature of the data from its source.

candidates.title: Maryland State Police Performance Dashboard - Quarterly Data
candidates.description: Data from the Maryland State Police (MSP) for the Governor's Office of Performance Improvement Dashboard.  This data is updated by MSP quarterly.  The data provided is accurate at the time of the query and maybe subject to change at a later date.
